title: AddressSanitizer crash triage
steps: Read the FIRST error: access type, address, allocation/free stack, and the faulting frame.
Classify (OOB read/write, UAF, double-free, stack overflow) and keep the minimized input.
falsifier: A clean ASan run means only that this input did not trigger a memory error; it does not prove the code is safe.
pitfalls: leak reports masking the real error
